<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
I suppose it's locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.

<CLT=cltMIND>You always tried to help us
in your own, strange way.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>
you discovered...

<CLT=cltMIND>A horrible truth.
To save us from that, you were willing to kill...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't imagine Kokichi would let this go.
He must be planning something...

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
I suppose it's locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
I suppose it's locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
I suppose it's locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
I suppose it's locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>You were so troublesome,
even at the very end.

<CLT=cltMIND>But still...you didn't have to die.
You didn't deserve to die like that, Miu...

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
I suppose it's locked.
